title: PerHalluEval: Persian Hallucination Evaluation Benchmark for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Benchmarking LLM hallucination detection specifically in Persian, a low-resource and morphologically complex language, to identify and address the performance and evaluation disparities compared to English and other well-resourced languages.

Manually annotating the evaluation dataset to separate 'Persian-specific' content (relating uniquely to Persian culture, history, or geography) from 'generic' content, and comparing the models' hallucination detection performance (Hamming scores) across the two subsets.

Analyzing the statistical disparity between Factual Recall and Hallucination Recall to uncover a 'Yes-Man' problem, identifying whether models exhibit a strong inclination (bias) toward affirming presented text as correct and non-hallucinated regardless of its actual factual accuracy.
